items.title: US Internship Program
items.content_html:
The opportunity

At Proxima, we don’t just advise clients, we deliver change. We are a specialist procurement consultancy that partners with some of the world’s most ambitious organizations to transform how they spend, source, and manage suppliers, unlocking measurable commercial and strategic value.

As part of Bain & Company’s global ecosystem, we operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, working side by side with clients to turn bold ideas into tangible results. Our purpose is simple and powerful: to drive purposeful and profitable change.

We are seeking aspiring consultants to join our Chicago team for an eight-week Summer Internship from June 7, 2027, to August 6, 2027. During the program, you will work alongside experienced consultants on client projects, gaining practical consulting and procurement experience and developing the professional capabilities required for success.

What You’ll Do

  • Receive a structured training program that covers procurement knowledge and consultancy skills

  • Gain an understanding of the range of businesses we work for and learn about procurement consultancy from experts in the field

  • Shadow and aid client teams to identify improvements and cost savings for global brands

  • Collaborate with other interns on a client simulation, experiencing how consulting teams work together to solve challenges and deliver recommendations to senior leaders at the end of the program

  • Build confidence as a communicator through weekly storytelling and presentation sessions, with regular opportunities to practice, receive feedback, and refine your approach

What We Offer

  • In addition to support from the program lead and your client team, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who will provide coaching, guidance, and support throughout the eight-week program

  • A robust training program with hands-on experience

  • Exposure to a range of employees and senior management across the business

  • The opportunity to be offered a full-time Associate Consultant role after you graduate

  • Great company culture

What We Are Looking For

  • Be a rising senior at university

  • Great problem-solving skills

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach to your work

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn and develop

  • Motivation to build a long-term consulting and procurement career in a growing global firm

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Process:

· Submit your application with video submission

· Screening call with TA team

· Virtual Interview with consulting team

· Q&A conversation with Associate Consultant

Who thrives here

You are:

  • Curious, commercially minded, and eager to learn

  • Comfortable working with data and structured problem-solving

  • Confident engaging with stakeholders and contributing to team delivery

  • Motivated by real outcomes and hands-on impact

  • Excited to grow with a fast-expanding global consultancy

Time to be bold.

Join Proxima and help leading organizations make smarter commercial decisions, strengthen supplier relationships, and unlock lasting value, while building a career supported by exceptional people.

Your office base will be in Chicago, IL. If successful you will be responsible for your own accommodation during the eight weeks of the internship.

items.title: Senior Azure Platform Engineer
items.content_html:
The opportunity

We are continuing a significant transformation of our technology estate, moving towards a predominantly cloud-native operating model built around Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

The Senior Azure Platform Engineer will therefore provide broad Azure platform engineering capability while also developing sufficient depth within Microsoft Fabric and data-platform technologies to provide resilience alongside our existing Cloud & Data Engineer.

The role offers:

  • Significant ownership of a growing Azure environment.

  • Hands-on involvement with Microsoft Fabric as it becomes a core enterprise data platform.

  • The opportunity to shape our cloud engineering standards and practices.

  • Significant scope for Infrastructure as Code and automation.

  • Exposure to identity, networking, security, data, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform technologies.

  • Direct involvement in cloud architecture and technology decision-making.

  • The opportunity to lead technical projects rather than simply receive implementation tasks.

  • A modernisation programme progressively reducing reliance on legacy and on-premises infrastructure.

  • Close working relationships with senior IT leadership, engineers, data specialists and external technology partners.

  • A senior technical career path that does not require moving into people management.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Azure Platform Engineering

Design, implement, maintain and improve services across the Azure estate. The role is not expected to personally administer every Microsoft technology but should have sufficient breadth to understand how services interact across a modern Microsoft cloud environment.

Microsoft Fabric & Data Platform

Work alongside the existing Cloud & Data Engineer to provide engineering resilience for Microsoft Fabric. The role is not intended to replace BI developers or become responsible for business reporting and visualisation. Instead, it supports the engineering platform on which those capabilities operate.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation, Integration

Help move the organisation towards repeatable, controlled and automated infrastructure management. The engineer should actively look for opportunities to replace fragile manual processes with reliable automation.

Identity, Security & Governance

Work with IT leadership and other technology teams to ensure Azure platforms are appropriately secured and governed. The engineer will be responsible for technical implementation of security controls, working alongside governance and assurance functions rather than replacing them.

Technical Project Delivery

Take technical ownership of projects and workstreams.

Operational Engineering

Although primarily an engineering/project role, the position will also act as a senior escalation point for complex platform issues. This is not intended to be a traditional infrastructure support position, but senior engineers are expected to retain operational ownership of the platforms they build.

Technical Skills

We are particularly interested in experience across the following areas.

Azure

  • Azure architecture and administration.

  • Azure networking.

  • Azure identity and RBAC.

  • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.

  • Azure Policy and governance.

  • Key Vault.

  • Private networking and Private Endpoints.

  • Azure security and Defender.

  • Azure storage and platform services.

  • Backup, resilience and disaster recovery concepts.

Engineering & Automation

  • Terraform and/or Bicep.

  • PowerShell.

  • Azure CLI.

  • Git.

  • CI/CD.

  • Infrastructure as Code.

  • Automated deployment and configuration management.

  • DevOps engineering practices.

Data Platforms

Experience with some combination of:

  • Microsoft Fabric.

  • Azure Databricks.

  • Azure Synapse.

  • Data Lake technologies.

  • Data pipelines and orchestration.

  • Notebooks.

  • Medallion/lakehouse architecture.

  • Data-platform security and identity.

  • Deployment and environment-management patterns.

Microsoft Cloud

Useful wider exposure includes:

  • Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Microsoft 365.

  • Microsoft Defender.

  • Power Platform.

  • Microsoft Purview.

  • Power BI/Fabric integration.

  • Deep expertise across every Microsoft service is not expected.
